name: fp_arms_suit
convention: eye at the origin looking down -Z, +Y up, +X right; metres; 16:9. The game draws the arms as a viewmodel (66 deg vertical FOV, model moved 0.02 m forward and 0.025 m up): screen positions are composed and checked with that (anim.vm / anim.to_vm, s7_strips.py)

clips.name: idle
clips.note: the rest: gloves low and wide, backs to the eye, fingers curled; slow float

clips.name: walk_sway
clips.note: magnetic-boot gait, 1.6 s = two steps: the left boot releases at t = 0 and locks at 0.8 s, when the right releases; the arms counter-swing +/-4 deg

refs.phase: clip time = gait phase (0..1 over two steps) * 1.6 s: play(walk_sway, {at}) / seek()

clips.name: hand_rest
clips.note: left hand resting palm-down on an edge (anchor_grip_L = the contact point), right at rest

clips.name: tool_idle
clips.note: right hand holds the pistol-grip tool low right

clips.name: tool_raise
clips.note: tool_idle -> tool on the bolt; left hand goes to its rest on the unit

clips.name: tool_drive
clips.note: push in, trigger, torque kick twists the wrist, settle (ends raised)

clips.name: plug_reach
clips.note: right hand forward to a loose connector, opening

clips.name: plug_hold
clips.note: three-finger pinch on the 4 cm connector shell

clips.name: plug_seat
clips.note: push forward 6 cm with a quarter twist; ends seated

clips.name: latch_flip
clips.note: index finger flicks the bale latch over the seated connector

clips.name: haul_idle
clips.note: both hands on the line: right hand leading (upper), left hand trailing (lower)

clips.name: haul_L
clips.note: left hand releases, reaches up the line past the right, wraps, pulls in; ends left leading / right trailing

clips.name: haul_R
clips.note: starts left leading / right trailing, ends in haul_idle

clips.name: haul_fumble
clips.note: missed grab with the LEFT hand (same hand twice); starts/ends left leading / right trailing

clips.name: haul_fumble_R
clips.note: missed grab with the RIGHT hand; starts/ends in haul_idle

clips.name: haul_float
clips.note: line slack: both hands have let go and hang low at the sides, thumbs up

clips.name: thrust_brace
clips.note: both arms forward and low, palms out, fingers together

clips.name: tumble_flail
clips.note: loose, drifting arms

clips.name: reach_handle
clips.note: SCRUBBED by QTE progress: tucked -> fully extended, fingers opening, trembling at full stretch

clips.name: grab_handle
clips.note: fingers snap closed on the 3.5 cm bar; ends in the hang pose

clips.name: hang_handle
clips.note: holding the bar, body swinging slightly

clips.name: grab_miss
clips.note: the rail goes by: the right hand closes on nothing and is thrown down to brace low on the right; the left lunges after the rail, fingers closing on air, and stays out. Starts from reach_handle fully extended; ends still reaching (cross-fade out of it)

clips.name: panel_pry
clips.note: right hand hooks the cover edge and pries it open; left hand stays at rest, out of the way

clips.name: door_pull
clips.note: both hands take a vertical pull handle (right above left) and heave the door off its seal; same timing as panel_pry

clips.name: jumper_clip
clips.note: right hand squeezes a clip open, places it on a terminal, lets go

clips.name: lever_pull
clips.note: reach the manual release lever, grip, haul it down; ends in lever_hold

clips.name: lever_hold
clips.note: holding the lever down, straining

clips.name: valve_turn
clips.note: both hands on a wheel valve, alternating strokes; wheel turns +128 deg (CCW seen by Karl) per loop

clips.name: glove_twist_L
clips.note: right hand grips the left wrist ring, twists it 38 deg, slides the glove off and carries it out lower-left

skeleton.rest_pose: arms straight ahead (-Z), thumbs up, palms facing each other
skeleton.notes: forearm_twist carries the twist component of the hand rotation: on the suit it is the glove half of the wrist bearing (rigid ring), all clips key it. If the game poses hand_* itself it must copy the twist about the forearm axis to forearm_twist_*. upper_arm_* may carry small translation keys (shoulder girdle reach).

usage.blend: Clips are authored to chain: tool_idle -> tool_raise -> tool_drive (ends raised) ; plug_reach -> plug_hold -> plug_seat -> latch_flip ; reach_handle (scrub 0..1 s) -> grab_handle -> hang_handle, or reach_handle -> grab_miss (ends still reaching) ; lever_pull -> lever_hold ; panel_pry (one hand, a cover edge) and door_pull (two hands, a pull handle) share their timing. Cross-fade 0.1-0.15 s elsewhere.
usage.haul: haul_idle = right hand leading (upper) / left hand trailing (lower); haul_L ends left leading / right trailing, haul_R starts there and ends in haul_idle; haul_fumble (left) and haul_fumble_R (right) start and end with their own hand leading. Each hand has two holds on its own side of the centre: refs lead_L/lead_R (higher) and trail_L/trail_R (lower, nearly as far out). The line BENDS at the leading fist: taut from the anchor to it, then across to the trailing fist (refs line_point + line_dir = that stretch between the fists as the clip ENDS, exact all through haul_idle and the fumbles), then to the reel. During haul_L / haul_R the reaching fist is open between the markers release and grip (refs release_s, grip_s): the line then runs through the other fist only. reach_grip = where the reaching hand closes on the taut line beyond the leading fist (aim it at the real line). haul_float = the line has gone slack: both hands let go and hang low at the sides, thumbs up, fingers curled; play it, or pose() it over a haul clip with a 0.15 s fade, and play haul_L / haul_R from it on the next reach.
usage.rest: idle is the rest: gloves low and wide, backs to the eye, fingers curled (see framing.rest). walk_sway is the same rest with the gait on it: clip time = gait phase x 1.6 s, the left boot releases at 0 and the right at 0.8 s (markers release_L / release_R); start it with play(walk_sway, {at}) and keep it in step with seek() / setRate(). hand_rest = the left hand palm-down on an edge; the same left hand is in tool_raise (it arrives), tool_drive, plug_reach (it arrives), plug_hold, plug_seat and latch_flip, so the free hand rests on the unit whenever the right hand works. In all of them anchor_grip_L is the contact point of the palm.
usage.pose_clips: plug_hold, thrust_brace and hand_rest are 2 identical keys 1/30 s apart (hold the first frame).
usage.anchor_grip: anchor_grip_L/R ride on the non-deforming bones grip_L/R. At rest they sit in the palm (+Z along a gripped bar from the little-finger side to the index side, +Y out of the palm). In plug_reach/plug_hold/plug_seat anchor_grip_R is moved to the mating face of the pinched connector (+Z = insertion direction); in jumper_clip to the jaw of the pinched clip.
usage.anchor_tool: anchor_tool_R (child of hand_R): tool origin at the centre of the pistol grip, +Z chuck axis away from the user, +Y up — matches tool_pgt.glb.
usage.glove_twist_L: glove_L is its own skinned mesh (hand_L, finger bones, forearm_twist_L = the glove half of the wrist bearing). In glove_twist_L hand_L and forearm_twist_L get translation keys: the glove leaves the sleeve and is carried out of frame lower-left by the right hand. Hide glove_L afterwards. The matching bare hand is fp_arms_crew.glb clip glove_off_L (same wrist path) — play both together and the bare hand is revealed as the glove slides off.

framing.about: Where the hands are on screen as the game draws the arms: fractions of the frame, x from the left, y from the top (0.5, 0.5 = centre), measured at the grip anchors. The clips are keyed to these directly: ARMS_TUNING.framing needs no entry for any of them.

viewmodel.projection: a point p in arm space is seen at x = 0.5 + 0.5 * p.x / (d * tan 33 * 16/9), y = 0.5 - 0.5 * (p.y + 0.025) / (d * tan 33), with d = 0.02 - p.z

rest.also: the free left hand of tool_idle, panel_pry, jumper_clip, lever_pull and lever_hold

walk.phase: clip time = gait phase x 1.6 s; the left boot releases at 0, the right at 0.8 s; the arm opposite the swinging leg leads

tuning.how: ARMS_TUNING.framing (game/src/player/arms/tuning.ts) takes entries {match: clip-name prefix, pitch: radians about the eye (+ = up), offset: [x, y, z] metres in arm space}; an entry rides the cross-fade of the clips it matches. A segment tunes a state by adding an entry for it.
tuning.rest_drop: {match: "idle", offset: [0, -d, 0]} and the same for "walk_" lower the rest by d metres
tuning.lateral_offset: one offset moves both hands the same way, so the width of the rest is keyed: REST_OUT in assets_src/fp_arms/clips_suit.py, then ./final.sh suit
tuning.haul: {match: "haul_", offset: [0, dy, 0]} moves both fists; the targets above are met with no entry

tool.frame: origin at the centre of the pistol grip, +Z = chuck axis away from the user, +Y up
tool.attach: no offset: tool_pgt.glb is modelled in this frame

connector.frame: +Z = the plug axis (insertion direction); the origin is 0.032 m ahead of the pinch of the thumb and the first two fingers
connector.attach: held by its BOOT: attach the connector with its axis on +Z and its mating face at the origin, then move it +0.035 m along +Z (prologue1 puzzle.holdOffset). The fingers are then on the boot and the collar shows above the thumb; the mating face is at origin + 0.035 Z, which is the point to bring to the socket.

jumper.frame: origin at the jaw of the pinched clip, +Z along the clip toward the jaw

line.frame: origin where the line passes through the fist, +Z along it from the little finger to the thumb side
line.note: the line runs anchor -> leading fist -> trailing fist -> reel; see usage.haul

bar.frame: origin on the axis of the gripped bar, +Z along the bar, +Y out of the palm

rest.frame: origin at the contact point of the palm, +Y into the surface, +Z along the edge (toward the body centre)
rest.pin: to put the palm on a real edge, aimAt(refs.rest_point of hand_rest, the world point) while the right hand is not aimed elsewhere: one aim moves both arms
